formats.key: swap(address caller, (address srcToken, address dstToken, address srcReceiver, address dstReceiver, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 flags, bytes permit) desc, bytes data)
effects: Takes desc.amount of desc.srcToken from the signer and sends it to desc.srcReceiver (the executor). For native srcToken, msg.value must equal desc.amount.
If flag bit 1 (_REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH) is set, msg.value may be larger than desc.amount (or nonzero for an ERC-20 swap). The extra native currency goes to the executor.
Spends the signer's existing srcToken allowance to the router, or first runs desc.permit on srcToken, which sets an allowance.
Sends the whole dstToken balance the router ends up with (at least desc.minReturnAmount) to desc.dstReceiver, or to msg.sender when dstReceiver is zero.
With flag bit 0 (_PARTIAL_FILL), unspent srcToken goes back to the signer and the minimum return is scaled down by the share actually spent.
formats.shown: "Swap", with the amount to send in srcToken, the minimum to receive in dstToken, and the beneficiary address. The executor, flags, permit and data are hidden, and so is msg.value.

findings.title: swap is payable, but msg.value is never shown and a hidden flag lets it exceed the shown amount
findings.evidence: AggregationRouterV4.swap: `if (flags & _REQUIRES_EXTRA_ETH != 0) { require(msg.value > (srcETH ? desc.amount : 0)) }` and `address(caller).call{value: msg.value}(callData)`. In the descriptor, desc.flags is visible: never and there is no @.value field.
findings.fix: Add a field `@.value` with format `amount` and label 'Native value sent', visible always.

findings.title: swap shows a zero dstReceiver as the zero address, but the code then pays msg.sender
findings.evidence: swap: `address payable dstReceiver = (desc.dstReceiver == address(0)) ? msg.sender : desc.dstReceiver;`. The descriptor uses `desc.dstReceiver` with `addressName` and no senderAddress.
findings.fix: Add params.senderAddress: ["0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000"] to the beneficiary field.

findings.title: swap's partial-fill flag makes the minimum received a prorated rate, not a fixed floor
findings.evidence: swap: `if (flags & _PARTIAL_FILL != 0) { ... srcToken.uniTransfer(msg.sender, unspentAmount); require(returnAmount.mul(desc.amount) >= desc.minReturnAmount.mul(spentAmount)) }`. desc.flags is visible: never, and the labels read 'Amount to Send' and 'Minimum to Receive'.
findings.fix: Label the amounts 'Maximum to send' and 'Minimum to receive (pro rata on partial fill)', or show the flags.

findings.title: swap runs a hidden permit on srcToken that sets an allowance; its spender and value are not shown
findings.evidence: swap: `_permit(address(srcToken), desc.permit)`. Permitable._permit calls `token.call(abi.encodePacked(IERC20Permit.permit.selector, permit))`. In the descriptor: `desc.permit` visible: never.
findings.fix: Show the permit spender and value using slices of desc.permit, or at least add a visible 'Includes token permit' field.

findings.title: swap intent is just 'Swap', with no interpolatedIntent naming the assets and amounts
findings.evidence: descriptor swap: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Swap {desc.amount} for at least {desc.minReturnAmount}".

findings.title: swap case 0 shows the source token as BUSD; the token moved is Binance-Peg USDC
findings.evidence: case 0: desc.srcToken 0x8ac76a51cc950d9822d68b83fe1ad97b32cd580d. The mined effect is a 'USDC' transfer out of 127.077634355394266428; the screen says '127.077634355394266428 BUSD'. The descriptor binds tokenPath to desc.srcToken correctly, so the wallet's token list gives the wrong symbol.
findings.fix: No descriptor change. Fix the token metadata source for BSC 0x8ac7…580d.

findings.title: swap spends the signer's existing srcToken allowance to the router, and nothing on screen says so
findings.evidence: case 0: the mined approval effect (signer grant) on USDC to router 0x1111…097d, remaining 50.83, comes from safeTransferFrom(msg.sender, desc.srcReceiver, desc.amount). This spends an allowance to the router the signer is swapping through.
findings.fix: None needed. This is the prerequisite of the swap.

cases.notes: USDC out: the amount is right but the screen calls the token BUSD (wallet metadata), so the reader thinks BUSD leaves. USDT in: 124.507 received, at least the 123.262 shown, to the signer. The allowance spend is not shown, and the reader saw no approval.

formats.key: unoswap(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes32[] pools)
effects: Takes `amount` of srcToken from the signer and sends it to the first pool. If srcToken is zero, msg.value must equal amount and is wrapped to WETH/WBNB.
Swaps through the packed pools and sends the output to msg.sender. If the last pool has the WETH flag, the output is unwrapped and sent as native currency.
Reverts if the output is below minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap", with the amount to send in srcToken, a minimum to receive with no token, the signer as beneficiary, and the last pool as an address.

findings.title: unoswap shows the minimum received without a token; the output token comes only from the pools
findings.evidence: descriptor unoswap: the `minReturn` field has no tokenPath. The output token comes from the pair reserves and swap in the `pools` loop of UnoswapRouter.unoswap, so no calldata parameter holds it.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. Consider a label like 'Minimum to receive (output token units)'.

findings.title: unoswap 'Last pool' formats a packed bytes32, with reverse, WETH and numerator bits, as an address
findings.evidence: UnoswapRouter.unoswap uses `and(rawPair, _ADDRESS_MASK)`, `_REVERSE_MASK`, `_WETH_MASK`, `_NUMERATOR_MASK`. The descriptor uses `pools.[-1]` with format addressName.
findings.fix: Use the path `pools.[-1].[12:32]` so only the pool address is formatted.

findings.title: unoswap intent 'Swap' gives no amounts, and there is no interpolatedIntent
findings.evidence: descriptor unoswap: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn}".

formats.key: unoswapWithPermit(address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, bytes32[] pools, bytes permit)
effects: Runs `permit` on srcToken, which sets an allowance for the spender inside the permit.
Takes `amount` of srcToken from the signer, swaps through the pools and sends the output to msg.sender (native if the last pool has the WETH flag).
Reverts if the output is below minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap", with the amount to send in srcToken, a minimum to receive with no token, the signer as beneficiary, and the last pool. The permit is hidden.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit runs a hidden permit that sets an allowance; its spender and value are not shown
findings.evidence: UnoswapRouter.unoswapWithPermit: `_permit(address(srcToken), permit);`. In the descriptor: `permit` visible: never.
findings.fix: Show the permit spender and value using slices of `permit`, or add a visible notice that a permit is submitted.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit shows the minimum received without a token; the output token comes only from the pools
findings.evidence: descriptor: the `minReturn` field has no tokenPath. The output token is decided by the pairs in `pools`.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit 'Last pool' formats a packed bytes32 as an address
findings.evidence: The descriptor uses `pools.[-1]` with addressName. The code masks it with `_ADDRESS_MASK` and reads its flag bits.
findings.fix: Use the path `pools.[-1].[12:32]`.

findings.title: unoswapWithPermit intent 'Swap' gives no amounts and no permit
findings.evidence: descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Permit and swap' and the interpolatedIntent "Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn}".

formats.key: uniswapV3Swap(uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools)
effects: Takes `amount` of the first pool's input token from the signer in the swap callback. If pools[0] has the wrap flag, msg.value must equal amount and is wrapped.
Swaps through the Uniswap V3 pools and sends the output to msg.sender. If the last pool has the unwrap flag, the output is unwrapped and sent as native currency.
Reverts if the output is below minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap", with an amount to send and a minimum to receive, neither with a token, the signer as beneficiary, and the last pool as an address.

findings.title: uniswapV3Swap shows the amount sent and the minimum received with no token; both tokens come from the pools
findings.evidence: descriptor uniswapV3Swap: `amount` and `minReturn` have no tokenPath. UnoswapV3Router.uniswapV3SwapCallback pays token0/token1 read from the pool (`staticcall(gas(), caller(), ...)`), so no calldata parameter holds the tokens.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. Labels could say the token is set by the first and last pool.

findings.title: uniswapV3Swap 'Last pool' formats a uint256 with direction, wrap and unwrap bits as an address
findings.evidence: UnoswapV3Router: `_ONE_FOR_ZERO_MASK = 1 << 255`, `_WETH_WRAP_MASK = 1 << 254`, `_WETH_UNWRAP_MASK = 1 << 253`. The descriptor uses `pools.[-1]` with addressName.
findings.fix: Use the path `pools.[-1].[12:32]`.

findings.title: uniswapV3Swap intent 'Swap' names no asset or amount
findings.evidence: descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn}".

formats.key: uniswapV3SwapTo(address recipient, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools)
effects: Takes `amount` of the first pool's input token from the signer, or msg.value wrapped when the wrap flag is set.
Swaps through the Uniswap V3 pools and sends the output to `recipient` (unwrapped to native if the last pool has the unwrap flag).
Reverts if the output is below minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap", with an amount to send and a minimum to receive, neither with a token, the recipient as beneficiary, and the last pool.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapTo shows the amounts with no token; the tokens come from the pools
findings.evidence: descriptor: `amount` and `minReturn` have no tokenPath. The callback pays token0/token1 read from the pool.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapTo 'Last pool' formats a uint256 with flag bits as an address
findings.evidence: The descriptor uses `pools.[-1]` with addressName. The code reads masks at bits 253-255.
findings.fix: Use the path `pools.[-1].[12:32]`.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapTo intent 'Swap' leaves out the amounts and the third-party recipient
findings.evidence: descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Add interpolatedIntent "Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn} to {recipient}".

formats.key: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit(address recipient, address srcToken, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturn, uint256[] pools, bytes permit)
effects: Runs `permit` on srcToken, which sets an allowance for the spender inside the permit.
Takes `amount` of the first pool's input token from the signer. That token comes from the pool; the code never checks it against srcToken.
Swaps through the Uniswap V3 pools and sends the output to `recipient` (native if the unwrap flag is set). Reverts below minReturn.
formats.shown: "Swap", with the amount to send in srcToken, a minimum to receive with no token, the recipient, and the last pool. The permit is hidden.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit labels the amount with srcToken, but the token taken is the first pool's input token
findings.evidence: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit only uses srcToken in `_permit(address(srcToken), permit)`. uniswapV3SwapCallback runs `token0.safeTransferFrom(payer, msg.sender, ...)` with token0/token1 read from the pool. The descriptor sets `amount` tokenPath to `srcToken`.
findings.fix: Label the field 'Amount to send (permit token)', or note that the swapped token is set by the first pool. No calldata path gives the enforced token.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit runs a hidden permit that sets an allowance; its spender and value are not shown
findings.evidence: `_permit(address(srcToken), permit);`. In the descriptor: `permit` visible: never.
findings.fix: Show the permit spender and value using slices of `permit`, or add a visible notice.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit shows the minimum received without a token
findings.evidence: descriptor: `minReturn` has no tokenPath. The output token comes from the last pool.
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit 'Last pool' formats a uint256 with flag bits as an address
findings.evidence: The descriptor uses `pools.[-1]` with addressName. The code reads masks at bits 253-255.
findings.fix: Use the path `pools.[-1].[12:32]`.

findings.title: uniswapV3SwapToWithPermit intent 'Swap' leaves out the amounts, the recipient and the permit
findings.evidence: descriptor: `"intent": "Swap"`, no interpolatedIntent.
findings.fix: Use the intent 'Permit and swap' and the interpolatedIntent "Swap {amount} for at least {minReturn} to {recipient}".
